scope: Offline-only analysis of already retained A0/B1/A0, no browser rerun, no new probes. Per side: longest qualified registered rAF wait, longest Page new-state gap, and slowest ordinary Save1 callback. All adverse windows remain. Same criterion is not a matched scene. Native input send-intent, relay receive/send and sampled authoritative frontier are distinct boundaries.
clockScope: Trace to its Page uses the full calibrated offset interval from three fixed marks. Cross-Page/relay alignment uses timeOrigin+performance.now only, approximate rather than calibrated OS arrival timing. Native absolute entry/exit are unavailable. Late window snapshots cannot establish native foreground state during any earlier interval.
inferenceLimits: Observed overlap is not a demonstrated blocking dependency or root cause.
Trace observer overhead is uncalibrated; graphics profile omits toplevel, renderer.scheduler and cc.
Input deadlines coalesced or unsubmitted are retained, never treated as zero-latency successes.
The switch sequence alone did not establish a reversible performance benefit: A1 poor, B1 better, A2 also better.

qualification.scope: Launch/measurement/trace qualification only; not evidence of a performance fix or physical scanout.

coverage.limitation: No events is not evidence of idle. Match the retained complete time window to existing rAF requests; a non-reproduced stall is not a repair.
